description_en: A narrow fainting couch with one high end, a low partial back and an open foot end; the front shows the asymmetric upholstered seat and woven apron, the side reveals the high curled headrest, and the rear exposes the stepped back frame and bound horizontal rails. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the canonical FRONT reference of this exact product. Create ONE photorealistic alternate catalog view of THAT SAME OBJECT, rotating viewpoint only. Subject: A narrow fainting couch with one high end, a low partial back and an open foot end; the front shows the asymmetric upholstered seat and woven apron, the side reveals the high curled headrest, and the rear exposes the stepped back frame and bound horizontal rails. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.. Style Zen: calm minimal ornament and simple proportions. Relative size compact within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: regular open hexagonal cane lattice with three strip directions. Finish: cinnabar red lacquer retaining clearly visible woven strip intersections. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact REAR ELEVATION: orbit camera 180 degrees from canonical front, level with product center, directly facing its back. Show rear supports, rear surfaces and described rear features. The front-facing features must be hidden on the opposite side. Do not mirror the front image. Preserve exact silhouette dimensions, finish color, weave, number and locations of all compartments, handles, legs, ribs, drawers, hinges, padding and secondary materials. Reveal the described previously hidden surfaces without redesigning the object. Match background, soft lighting, scale and center placement. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.
